steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's summary page.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu and launch the Recreate Order dialog.

args.goal: In the Recreate Order dialog, keep the bidding end duration at 30 Mins, select 60 Mins for Evaluation Duration, click Create Order, and stop on the resulting new event screen showing a 60-minute evaluation window after the 30-minute bidding period.

steps.note: Perform and verify the recreate configuration and resulting evaluation window on the buyer screen.
Confirm the recreated event flow completed without an application error.
